mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI growth above 2.5% does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE below 4% does not correlate with subsequent wage inflation.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in retail sales (RSAFS) over the previous 3 months signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns do not show a significant positive trend following RSAFS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the previous 3 months signals a weakening supply side, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decline does not correlate with subsequent negative economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and CPIAUCSL growth exceeds 2%, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction between FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL does not correlate with subsequent tightening actions by the Fed.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) declines by more than 100,000 over the previous 3 months, the combination signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction between UNRATE and PAYEMS does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% over the previous 3 months signals strong demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increase does not correlate with subsequent positive economic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth slows to less than 1% quarter-over-quarter and industrial production (INDPRO) declines by more than 1%, the combination signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 1% QoQ and INDPRO declines > 1%
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction between GDPC1 and INDPRO does not correlate with subsequent economic weakness.
